description: This file contains C source code implementing DRM platform initialization, deinitialization, and decrypt functions for PlayReady. It includes functions for handling opaque secure content pointers, logging, and integrating DRM decryption routines.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_init()
methods.description: Initializes the DRM platform, logs a warning message, and returns success.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_deinit()
methods.description: Deinitializes the DRM platform, logs a warning message, and returns success.
